name: task-server-admission-responsibility
goal: Preserve module responsibility and reject incomplete module metadata before task queue mutation.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: ModuleTaskServerService.submit admits a task with an active committed module whose declared responsibility is non-empty. Expected task.moduleGoal to preserve that exact responsibility even when the incoming task omits moduleGoal; the focused existing service test currently receives undefined.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The module-tasks scenario already registers test/services/agents-providers/module-task.test.ts under services-agents-providers-module-task. Its existing admission case covered ModuleTaskService.add but not ModuleTaskServerService.submit or a missing-moduleGoal lifecycle. Extended that same registered case and title with a committed-contract fixture and exact moduleGoal assertion; case count stays fixed.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness red regression checkpoint f82932d36d108290e20b666640853c62747f3c03b8a861e98b1c804b8b234c9b at test commit f2f45dae737642ac6df1656ed0cef204bedd1d0b; the registered admission case failed because task.moduleGoal was undefined instead of the committed module responsibility.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fix commit 98d62f58ccbddd8d2295dcb332a09bc66118a32f populates each prepared task.moduleGoal from the exact non-empty selected-commit module responsibility, validates the canonical task before file-grant preparation, preserves the submitted wantedContract, and rejects a missing or blank responsibility before queue mutation. Helper and server contracts were updated through harness units contract.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Harness green regression checkpoint 256f9c1af3da5b2d9d6cfae240239807510a18cd11eb037344d94c9155e7e9a1 passed at fix commit 98d62f58ccbddd8d2295dcb332a09bc66118a32f using the unchanged test file, title, command, units, and environment profile.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
